text: Shorten README into setup and commands. Move rule examples and enforcement to docs/rules.md. Move runtimes, review narrative, parallel sessions, audit log, team rollout, storage details, limitations, and roadmap to docs/guide.md. Harden implementation: long-line hash chain and serialized appends in src/archrev/storage.py; cache parsed events and compiled rule regexes in src/archrev/storage.py and src/archrev/rules.py; honor exempt paths on reads in src/archrev/gate.py; quote check-rule file args in src/archrev/quality.py; close syntax-check files in src/archrev/syntaxcheck.py; stop the commit trailer at expired sessions in src/archrev/trailer.py; treat Grep as a read in src/archrev/adapters.py; cache worktree fingerprints in src/archrev/worktree.py; gitignore runtime lock and cache files in src/archrev/scaffold.py and .gitignore; correct the exempt comment in .archrev/config.yaml. Tests: tests/test_storage.py, tests/test_gate.py, tests/test_hooks.py, tests/test_quality.py, tests/test_scope.py, tests/test_trailer.py.

prompt_rules.policy: Any change to hook handling (src/archrev/hooks.py, src/archrev/cli.py hook command) must preserve fail-open behavior: hooks may never raise, block the editor on internal errors, or break git commits.
Changes to session file formats (events.jsonl, meta.json, manifest.json) must remain readable for existing records and be reflected in the README storage section.
New or changed behavior in globmatch, rules, gate, storage, planning, drift, or trailer is covered by pytest before the session ends.

note: Fail-open stays: append locking and caches never raise out of hooks. Event schema stays backward-compatible and the README keeps a storage section. New storage, gate, rules, and trailer behavior gets pytest coverage.
